title: Mixed Event — This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day — Episode6 Idol Aura Overflow

meta.Event: This Way! That Way! Zookeeper Day
meta.Event Outline: Fresh second-years Minori and Shiho are on the animal caretaker committee, and their work has already begun. When they learn about a shadowing opportunity at Odaiba Animal Land from a teacher, they decide to participate. Animal antics ensue!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Working with the animals was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, but I'm also looking forward to seeing what goes on behind the scenes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
And how great is it that we get to go around the zoo during our break?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Where should we go?!
I really wanna see the Savannah Area!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, it could be fun to see what animals they have there. Why don't we head over and—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That slim frame and beautiful posture...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The outfit she's wearing looks so simple, but she gives off this aura of being extraordinary...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
It must be her!
The idol who's loved by everyone and continues to evolve every day! Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
No, there's no way.
Yeah, she looks pretty similar, but what are the odds of—

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, Haruka!
Things took a little longer than expected at checkout...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, you two!
What brings you both here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Minori...!
Oh, and you're with Hinomori...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Well...
Since the cat's out of the bag.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After we heard that you'd both be shadowing here today, we planned to try to surprise you once you were all done.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We invited Saki, but she had a conflict.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
O-Oh, okay...
I had no idea that you guys were planning anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But our cover's blown.
We didn't realize that it'd be over this soon.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Actually, we're not done yet.
We're on break, and they said it was okay to check out the rest of the zoo.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah.
So we have to head back when our break's over.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But we still have time to hang out.
Let's go around the zoo together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay.
If you two still have time, then let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The two of us were planning on going around the zoo anyway while we waited for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The Savannah Area was so cool!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, the servals and caracals were really cute.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
I didn't know that they were carnivores.
It was surprising to hear that they eat moles.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Alright, where should we go next?!
Based on this pamphlet, the Wetland Area's right near here!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
They have all sorts of fish, frogs and birds!
And lots and lots of different plants, and—

rows.Speaker: Guests
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
Look at him go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wh-What's going on?
Everyone seems excited suddenly—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? What's wrong...?
Why do you all look so surprised?

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line:
Oh, look at that...
Dylan's escaped again.

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line: Yes, Dylan the armadillo's become quite the escape artist because he likes going for strolls around the zoo so much.

rows.Speaker: Female Regular
rows.Line: That said, the staff are quick to catch on, so it always ends with him getting chased around. His escape attempts have lately become one of this zoo's unofficial attractions...

rows.Speaker: Second-Year A
rows.Line:
Hey, that sounds like fun!
Odaiba Animal Land's a fully indoor zoo, right?

rows.Speaker: Second-Year B
rows.Line:
Yeah, they're pretty rare.
I remember seeing on TV how everyone goes to see the armadillos!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Now I see...
This is what everyone was talking about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I've never seen one before in real life...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, if the staff are always chasing him around, shouldn't we tell them that he's here?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Good point!
Since I'm here as a zookeeper for a day, I can't let him out of my sight!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay, Dylan, it's time to go home!
Lemme carry you over so that the staff can—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no!
Dylan's making a run for—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Did you see the way he ran?!
The way he scurried along on his little legs was too adorable!!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm not sure now's the right time to be gushing over him.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
For now, Minori and I will try to catch him.
Sorry, Kiritani, but can you let the staff know for us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, Private Ichika, you can catch him with us! It's time for us to commence Operation: Detain Dylan!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
He's so much faster than I expected!
I haven't even been able to get close!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Plus, we can't really keep him in our sights because of all these people...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, we can see him just barely now, but we'll lose him the second he runs into— *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wow, he really disappeared!
Where'd he go?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-He was running in this direction, so he couldn't have gone very far...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (The others probably believe that was someone from the crowd just now. But I'm guessing it was really...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We're bound to succeed if she can help us!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (We've gotta catch Dylan no matter what...!)
